group.passage:
For most of human history, anyone who looked up on a clear night could see thousands of stars. Over most modern cities, however, the glow from streetlights, shop windows, and office towers is now strong enough to [[1]] the Milky Way completely. Studies suggest that more than a third of the world’s people can no longer see it from where they live.
Wildlife suffers as well. Newly hatched sea turtles, for example, find their way to the ocean by heading toward the brighter horizon above the water, but the lights of beachfront hotels can [[2]] them inland, where many never reach the sea. Birds that migrate at night face a similar danger: drawn toward brightly lit towers, they often circle until exhausted or crash into the glass. For these animals, artificial light is far more than a nuisance; it can be [[3]].
Our health may suffer too, and some scientists warn that we pay a [[4]] for our bright nights. The body relies on darkness as a [[5]] that it is time to rest, since the brain releases melatonin, a hormone that makes us sleepy, mainly when the light around us fades. Bright screens and lamps late at night can hold back this process, making it harder to fall asleep. Much of this [[6]] light is simply wasted, shining up into the sky, where it helps no one.
Fortunately, light pollution is one of the easiest environmental problems to solve, since the dark returns the moment the lights go off. Towns can fit streetlamps with covers that point their light downward, where it is actually needed. They can also [[7]] the lamps after midnight rather than switching them off completely. Because skies free of artificial light have become so [[8]] in crowded regions, some areas now protect them as “dark-sky parks.” Visitors from brightly lit cities [[9]] to these parks just to gaze at the stars. In a world that never sleeps, true darkness has become a [[10]] that many people never get to enjoy.

tags.topic: light pollution and its effects on wildlife, sleep, and the night sky

1.explanation_zh: blot out 是「遮蔽、使完全看不見」（blot 原指墨漬，這裡是延伸義）。城市的光強到能把整條銀河「完全遮住」，句中的 completely 與下一句的 can no longer see it（再也看不到它）都說明是看不見，而不只是變暗。
evidence: Over most modern cities, however, the glow from streetlights, shop windows, and office towers is now strong enough to [[1]] the Milky Way completely.
Studies suggest that more than a third of the world’s people can no longer see it from where they live.

option_notes_zh.A: price 當動詞是「定價」，price the Milky Way 不通。
option_notes_zh.B: flock 當動詞是不及物（成群前往），後面不能接受詞 the Milky Way。
option_notes_zh.C: sign 當動詞是「簽名」，sign the Milky Way 不通。
option_notes_zh.D: stray（形容詞，走失的；散逸的、偏離方向的）不合：空格在 strong enough to ___ the Milky Way completely 中，to 後面需要及物動詞原形。
option_notes_zh.E: fatal（形容詞，致命的）不合：空格在 strong enough to ___ the Milky Way completely 中，to 後面需要及物動詞原形。
option_notes_zh.G: rare（形容詞，罕見的、稀少的）不合：空格在 strong enough to ___ the Milky Way completely 中，to 後面需要及物動詞原形。
option_notes_zh.H: steer 是「引導…的方向」，steer the Milky Way 不通。
option_notes_zh.I: dim 也有「使變暗」的意思，但只是讓亮度降低、仍看得到；本句有 completely，下一句又說三分之一以上的人 can no longer see it（再也看不到），要選「完全遮蔽」。dim 屬於第 7 格「把路燈調暗」。
option_notes_zh.J: luxury（名詞，奢侈品、難得的享受）不合：空格在 strong enough to ___ the Milky Way completely 中，to 後面需要及物動詞原形。

1.strategy_zh: blot out 與 dim 都和「光線變少、看不清」有關，用 completely 與下一句 can no longer see it 判斷是「完全看不見」。
hints: 空格在 to 之後，需要及物動詞原形，受詞是 the Milky Way。

evidence: Newly hatched sea turtles, for example, find their way to the ocean by heading toward the brighter horizon above the water, but the lights of beachfront hotels can [[2]] them inland, where many never reach the sea.

2.strategy_zh: but 前後對比：小海龜原本朝海走，燈光卻讓牠們往內陸走。找一個「動詞＋受詞＋方向」說得通、意思是「引導」的字。

translation_zh.text:
在人類歷史的大部分時間裡，任何人在晴朗的夜晚抬頭，都能看見成千上萬顆星星。然而，在大多數現代城市上空，來自路燈、商店櫥窗和辦公大樓的光，如今已強到足以把銀河完全遮蔽。研究指出，全世界超過三分之一的人，在自己居住的地方已經看不到銀河。
野生動物也深受其害。例如，剛孵化的海龜會朝著海面上方較亮的地平線前進，藉此找到通往大海的路，但海濱飯店的燈光可能把牠們引向內陸，許多海龜因此始終到不了海裡。夜間遷徙的鳥類也面臨類似的危險：牠們被燈火通明的高樓吸引，常常盤旋到筋疲力盡，或撞上玻璃。對這些動物來說，人造光遠不只是麻煩而已，它可能是致命的。
我們的健康也可能受損，有些科學家警告，我們正為明亮的夜晚付出代價。身體依賴黑暗作為該休息了的訊號，因為大腦主要是在周圍光線變暗時，才分泌讓人想睡的荷爾蒙褪黑激素。深夜明亮的螢幕和燈光會抑制這個過程，使人更難入睡。這些散逸的光大多白白浪費，照向天空，對誰都沒有幫助。
所幸，光害是最容易解決的環境問題之一，因為燈一關，黑暗就回來了。城鎮可以為路燈加裝燈罩，讓光朝下照向真正需要的地方。他們也可以在午夜後把路燈調暗，而不是完全關掉。由於在人口稠密的地區，沒有人造光的天空已變得十分罕見，有些地方現在把這樣的天空劃為「暗空公園」加以保護。來自燈火通明城市的遊客成群湧向這些公園，只為了仰望星空。在這個永不入睡的世界裡，真正的黑暗已成為許多人無緣享受的奢侈。
